option_relations.rationale: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a syndrome, while the leaf is a specific type of lymphoma with secondary HLH. They are not equivalent.
Infectious Mononucleosis (EBV-associated HLH) is an infectious cause of HLH, not a specific lymphoma diagnosis. The leaf is a specific type of lymphoma with secondary HLH.

Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma (SPTCL) with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a specific type of T-cell lymphoma, but it is not the same as Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma (nasal-type or non-nasal) with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH).

Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified is a broad category of T-cell lymphomas, but it is not equivalent to the specific diagnosis of Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma (nasal-type or non-nasal) with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH).
